text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Gentil-san. I challenge you to a mock 
race.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Your spirit to rise no matter how many 
times you're defeated is commendable. 
...By the way, Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to look at my schedule 
book? It's already completely filled with 
plans with you. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I see... I apologize for the 
inconvenience. Whenever is convenient for 
you is fine."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Very well. It is not as if I am blaming 
you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
This is a duty, after all. The duty of the 
strong, and of those who are continually 
challenged.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Being busy is proof of strength. My 
schedule is adorned with victories.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now then, on which day will you allow me 
to place a star next, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...In three days. I shall carve a scorched 
mark of defeat into you on that very 
day...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, then please enjoy your fleeting 
moment in the sky. Like a comet right 
before burning out.
